profile_text.body:
SpaceX, formally SPACE EXPLORATION TECHNOLOGIES CORP, is a public company headquartered at Starbase, Texas, trading under the ticker SPCX. According to its own site, the company designs, manufactures and launches advanced rockets and spacecraft. It was founded in 2002, and the site states its ultimate goal is enabling people to live on other planets.

The site describes the company's work as aimed at revolutionizing space technology. No AI products are tracked for the company, and no MCP servers are listed.

The company's legal exposure is recorded in Texas, with 126 cases. It has an SEC filing record under CIK 0001181412.
